# Lelion Autoparts - Wiper Blade Manufacturer in Ningbo, China

> LELION (legal name Ningbo Zhenhai Bowang Autoparts Co., Ltd., 宁波镇海博王汽车配件有限公司) designs and manufactures windshield wiper blades for distributors, wholesalers and private-label brands: universal, hybrid, multifunction, frame, specific-fit, rear, bus/truck, snow and electric-spray blades, plus wiper arms and rubber refills. Factory in Zhenhai, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China since 2007.

## Company facts

- Founded: 2007, Zhenhai District, Ningbo, Zhejiang, China
Note: other year numbers elsewhere in this file are vehicle fitment ranges, not company dates.
- Factory area: 20,000+ m² across two factories (Ningbo, Zhejiang + Pingxiang, Jiangxi); plus an 8,000 m² warehouse near Ningbo port
- Annual output: 10M+ wiper blades (50,000 pcs per day), 128+ staff including 5+ R&D
- Quality: ISO 9001:2015 (No. 134956, NQA); CE (No. M.2022.206.C79712, UDEM)
- Durability: tested to 1,500,000+ wipe cycles
- MOQ: 500 pcs per order; 100 pcs per size for most models
- Lead time: 7 working days for in-stock items; 15-35 working days for OEM/ODM and custom orders
- Sampling: 7-15 days, free samples for quality evaluation
- Export markets: 60+ countries, shipped from Ningbo port
- Payment: T/T (30% deposit, 70% against B/L copy), L/C at sight, Western Union for sample orders, credit/debit cards, Apple Pay, Google Pay, Afterpay and Alipay.
- Site languages: English, Spanish, Russian, French, German, Chinese

Frequently asked questions:

**Q: Who manufactures LELION wiper blades?**
A: LELION is manufactured by Ningbo Zhenhai Bowang Autoparts Co., Ltd., founded in 2007 in Ningbo, China.

**Q: How many wiper blades can the factory produce each year?**
A: Over 10 million wiper blades per year (50,000 pcs per day) from 20,000+ m² of factory space across two factories, plus an 8,000 m² warehouse near Ningbo port.

**Q: What is the minimum order quantity?**
A: 500 pieces per order, with 100 pieces per size for most models.

**Q: How long do samples and production take?**
A: Free samples for quality evaluation take 7–15 days. In-stock items ship in 7 working days; OEM/ODM and custom orders take 15–35 working days.

**Q: Is LELION certified?**
A: The manufacturing system is certified to ISO 9001:2015 (No. 134956, NQA) and products carry CE certification (No. M.2022.206.C79712, UDEM).

## Product categories

- [Universal](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/universal): Flat and frameless blades with U-hook or multi-adapter fitting, 12-28 inch
- [Hybrid](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/hybrid): Three-section hybrid blades combining frame stability with beam aerodynamics
- [Multifunction](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/multifunction): Universal blades supplied with a 22-piece adapter set for 98% vehicle coverage
- [Frame wiper](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/frame-wiper): Conventional metal-frame blades for budget and older-vehicle ranges
- [Specific fit](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/specific-fit): Vehicle-specific front blade sets matched to make, model and year
- [Specific fit frame](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/specific-fit-frame-wiper): Vehicle-specific metal-frame blades
- [Rear wiper](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/rear-wiper): Universal and vehicle-specific rear blades
- [Rear wiper combo](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/rear-wiper-combo): Rear blade and arm sets sold as one SKU
- [Wiper arm](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/wiper-arm): Front and rear wiper arms, including left- and right-hand-drive variants
- [Colored wiper blade](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/colored-wiper-blade): Colored and printed blades for private-label and retail programmes
- [Electric spray wiper](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/electric-spray-wiper): Integrated washer-jet blades that spray directly onto the glass
- [Bus and truck wiper](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/bus-truck-wiper): Heavy-duty blades and arms for buses, coaches and trucks
- [Snow wiper](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/snow-wiper): Winter blades for snow and ice conditions
- [Wiper parts](https://www.lelionautopart.com/en/products/category/wiper-parts): Replacement rubber refills and component parts
